title: configuration.importcompare
description: Compare an import file with current system elements and show what will be changed if the file is imported.

format.description: Format of the serialized string. Possible values: yaml - YAML; xml - XML; json - JSON.

source.description: Serialized string containing the configuration data.

rules.description: Rules on how new and existing objects should be imported. Admin and User type users may compare new objects only with existing ones for which they have read-only or read-write permission. If no rules are given, there will be nothing to update and result will be empty. Comparison will be done only for host groups and templates. Triggers and graphs will be compared only for imported templates, any other will be considered as "new".

discoveryRules.description: Rules on how to import LLD rules.

createMissing.description: If set to true, new LLD rules will be created. Default: false.

updateExisting.description: If set to true, existing LLD rules will be updated. Default: false.

deleteMissing.description: If set to true, LLD rules not present in the imported data will be deleted from the database. Default: false.

updateExisting.description: If set to true, existing graphs will be updated. Default: false.

deleteMissing.description: If set to true, graphs not present in the imported data will be deleted from the database. Default: false.

deleteMissing.description: If set to true, templates that are linked to the host or template being imported, but are not present in the imported data, will be unlinked without removing entities (items, triggers, etc.) inherited from the unlinked templates. Default: false.
